name: Protection
description:
You touch a creature and ward it against harm. Roll Spirit to set the Difficulty.

Whenever a creature targets the protected creature with a spell, the caster must roll Spirit against the Difficulty. On a pass, the spell is cast normally. On a failure, the spell fails and any spent MP is lost.

Whenever the protected creature takes damage, reduce the damage by an amount equal to the Difficulty. Then reduce the Difficulty by the same amount.

If the Difficulty is reduced to 0, this spell immediately ends.
successes:
✨: Increase the Difficulty by 2.

🌞: Add HEART to the Difficulty.
